name: The SteelDrivers
notes: "Uncle pen meets Muscle Shoals" — bluegrass instrumentation playing blues form with a rasped soul lead, and therefore "the one entry in this section where the twelve-bar blues and minor-mode writing dominate over I–IV–V". The 2008–2010 Chris Stapleton lineup is the defining parameter set and the era starts there. Harmony is the identity: "model i–iv–v, i–♭VII–♭VI–V, and twelve-bar blues in minor, alongside the conventional major I–IV–V", with keys clustering in "A minor, B minor, E minor and D minor, i.e. fiddle-friendly minors rather than the genre's usual bright majors" — so the keys are authored as those four with `scales` weighted to natural_minor, dorian and blues, and the minor twelve-bar skeleton i–iv–i–V–iv–i sits at `maxChords` 6. The one drum parameter that is genuinely theirs is stated as a placement, not a feel: "the backbeat the mandolin chop placed swung rather than driven — this band sits at the boundary with country-shuffle, and the swung-offbeat setting is what gives them their blues lope". `snare.offGridMs` is therefore +7, the only positive backbeat offset in this section; the subdivision stays even, which is what keeps the band inside country-train rather than in country-shuffle. "Where a kit appears on the Muscle Shoals material it plays a straight 8th stream with a heavy backbeat", hence a stick-range accent tier despite the drummerless core. The bass is "root–five with far more walking than the bluegrass norm (blues form demands it)", so `rhythm` is independent_riff at `followRootsProb` 0.72 with a tritone in the passing tones for the blues fifth. The vocal is "a rasped, blues-phrased baritone with heavy back-phrasing and melisma — the opposite of the Krauss/McCoury bluegrass vocal convention", which is the low register, the raised `halfStepDissonance` and legato articulation. ⚠ This entry models the BAND, not Chris Stapleton; his full entry is in country-pop and is not duplicated here. ⚠ The entry is explicit that "the harmonic parameter set is inferred from the documented genre fusion and marked [LOW-CONF]", including the key cluster, and that flag is repeated. ⚠ Also INFERRED: `bpm.mode` 130 (the entry states a 90–180 band and no centre), the velocity tiers, the +7 ms value itself, `percs` contents and every melody and countermelody number.
